Reported Behavior Issue: Cable Theft Issue
solution:
As the customer reported, and after our check of the charger in the SCB, we can see that both
Outlets
are off, which means we should replace the charger cables.
I will send you the reference number for the cable that must be replaced. Please note that you will need two cables, one for each side:
Charging Cable CCS2 250A 1000V 5,82m – 8EM5903-0AA02-6AA2
